summary: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026 to furnish historical audited financials of Silver47 Exploration Corp. and Summa Silver Corp., plus unaudited pro forma combined information, for incorporation by reference into its registration statements. The disclosure relates to a previously reported August 20, 2026 Arrangement Agreement under which Bunker Hill will acquire all issued and outstanding common shares of Silver47, a British Columbia corporation; the company states the Arrangement remains uncompleted and this filing should not be construed as an indication it will close.
